prompt.description: The text description of the scene, subject, or action to generate in the video.

last_image_url.description: A direct link to an online image or a Base64-encoded local image to be used as the last frame of the video.

reference_image_urls.description: Passing an image reference allows the model to emulate the style or content of the reference in the output.

video_urls.description: Passing a video reference allows the model to emulate the style or content of the reference in the output.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio clips whose voice timbre the generated speech follows. Cannot be the only reference — pass at least one reference image or video alongside.

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output video, where the number refers to the short side in pixels.

ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Defaults to `adaptive`, which follows the first/last frame or reference input; text-only generation cannot be `adaptive` and defaults to `16:9` instead.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api.aimlapi.com/v2/video/generations' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_AIMLAPI_KEY>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model": "minimax/h3", "prompt": "Describe what you want the model to generate.", "image_url": "https://example.com/input.jpg", "duration": 6}'
